## Bracket Bust Sweepstakes — X Ads recap

**Flight:** Mar 30 – Apr 5, 2027 (7 days, Central)
**Total spend:** **$543.65** of the $550.00 budget (98.8%)
**Impressions:** **470,969**
**Link clicks:** **319**

**Derived:** CPC **$1.70** · CTR **0.068%** · CPM $1.15 · 3,402 total engagements

### By ad group

| Ad group | Targeting | Spend | Impressions | Link clicks | CPC | CTR |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Keywords | US + 21+ + 7 broad keywords | $281.62 | 176,095 | 167 | $1.69 | 0.095% |
| Broad | US + 21+ | $224.86 | 268,307 | 140 | $1.61 | 0.052% |
| Interests | US + 21+ + Food/Drinks + Sports/Basketball | $37.17 | 26,567 | 12 | $3.10 | 0.045% |

### What happened
- **Keywords was the workhorse** — highest click-through rate and the most link clicks, and it stood up as I scaled its budget.
- **Broad was cheap and steady** but traffic quality was weaker (more impressions, lower CTR); it improved when I pulled its budget back down mid-flight.
- **Interests never got efficient** (~$3.10/click vs ~$1.7), so I paused it after two days and moved that budget to the two working groups.
- **Creative:** post **2169484556499105334** ("Bracket busted… couch still deserves a 65-inch") was the clear winner — **252 of 319 link clicks (79%)** at a $1.69 CPC, versus 67 clicks at $1.77 for the other post. X's delivery shifted spend toward it on its own.
- Budget was reallocated a few times based on daily results, and the final two (peak) days were increased to $84/day while staying under the cap. All ad groups carried **US-only + 21-and-over** targeting for alcohol compliance, and ran both approved posts only.

### The honest caveat
X can't see your entries because there's no pixel, so **link clicks are the closest proxy we have** — not a guaranteed entry count. Some clicks won't complete the form, and some entries will come from non-ad channels. When you match this against your entry count, the useful ratio is **entries ÷ 319 link clicks** — that tells you how well the landing page converts, and is the first thing I'd fix before the next flight.

Go cherries 🍒
